question: The simplified value of 4 × ( 17 × ( 3² )) ÷ 12 + 26 − 41 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Evaluate power first: 3² = 9

Expression becomes: 4 × 17 × 9 ÷ 12 + 26 − 41

Cancel: 4/12 = 1/3 ⇒ 17 × 9 ÷ 3 = 17 × 3 = 51

Now: 51 + 26 − 41

**∴ Answer = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4 × (17 × (3²)) ÷ 12 + 26 − 41

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4 × (17 × 9) ÷ 12 + 26 − 41

⇒ 4 × 153 ÷ 12 + 26 − 41

⇒ 612 ÷ 12 + 26 − 41

⇒ 51 + 26 − 41

⇒ 77 − 41

⇒ 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Brackets, Orders (powers), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

Order of Operations

Solve powers first, then × and ÷ from left to right, then + and −

Simplification Trick

Cancel common factors early to reduce calculation
